teacher_info.about_teacher: I love teaching and helping students to feel more comfortable and confident speaking English in real-world conversations.  I am also a language learner.  I have lived abroad in Spain and France and I know how difficult and scary it can be to practice speaking in a new language.  I know how important it is to find a teacher with whom you feel very comfortable and safe so that you can practice speaking, ask questions, and take risks.  This is the best way to take your skills to the next level!  It is my goal to be that teacher for you!  My teaching style is relational, I am invested in my students and I am so excited to see you gaining confidence in your speaking ability!
teacher_info.teaching_style: My adult lessons are conversation-based and thematic.  Each lesson will be centered on a topic and I will ask you related discussion questions.  I can provide you with questions before class so that you can prepare, if that makes you more comfortable.  The classes are relaxed and feel much like having a conversation with a friend. I will also include important grammar points and pronunciation points when they arise in class.  I will also provide you with new vocabulary and phrases/idioms during each class so that your vocabulary is always expanding. Some examples of class topics are: introductions, hobbies, free time, sports, movies, books, food, family, holidays, music, and many more!

While most of my teaching experience is in Spanish-speaking countries, my background in Anthropology allows me to connect with people from all over the world. While living abroad, I quickly realized that grammar and pronunciation were not the most important parts of language learning. The key is confidence! Remaining silent for fear of making mistakes hurts you more in the end. Mistakes are opportunities to learn, so don't let insecurity keep you from communicating! Why is it easier for us to repeat song lyrics in another language than to remember the verb tenses (past, present, future)? You might say that the first is entertaining while the second is serious. Well, I happen to believe that learning a new language can be just as fun. I customize topics based on what you are interested in: nature, music, sports, food, etc. I also challenge my students to incorporate English into their daily life through movies, social media, games, books, etc. Sound fun? pro_course_detail.title: Intermediate English (B1-B2)
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you tired of feeling that you're never improving? Are you constantly repeating the same vocabulary and structures? 

In this class, you can expect: 
 ✔️ Controlled grammar and speaking practices with intermediate concepts, such as conditionals or past tenses. 
 ✔️ Vocabulary growth with speaking, listening, and reading activities and real authentic materials, such as the news, podcasts, YouTube, etc. 
✔️ Discussions on a wide variety of topics to push you to apply what you are learning. 
 ✔️ On-the-spot error correction documented for you to review your grammar, vocab, and pronunciation mistakes. 

*All* materials and notes will be sent to you after the class for review. Homework may be given to prepare for the next class. Let's get started! 🚀

pro_course_detail.title: Advanced English (C1-C2)
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you an advanced speaker of English but are lacking consistent practice? Do you feel like you have reached a plateau in your vocabulary? 

In this class, you can expect: 
 ✔️ Controlled grammar and speaking practice of advanced grammar concepts, such as phrasal verbs and verb formation. 
 ✔️ Vocabulary growth through challenging English materials, such as NPR/BBC news, podcasts, music.
✔️ Engage in discussions on diverse topics, from social issues to global news, encouraging you to push your speech.
 ✔️ On-the-spot error correction documented for you to review your grammar, vocab, and pronunciation mistakes. 

*All* materials and notes will be sent to you after the class for review. Homework may be given to prepare for the next class. Let's get started! 🚀

pro_course_detail.title: Structured Conversation Class
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you tired of feeling that you can't express yourself? Are you tired of only speaking about the same topics over and over again with no improvement? 

In this class, you can expect: 
✔️ Discussions on a wide variety of topics with material -- this can include the news (adjusted to your level), videos, or picture description activities. 
 ✔️ Vocabulary, idioms, and cultural references to grow your lexical resources.
 ✔️ On-the-spot error correction documented for you to review your grammar, vocab, and pronunciation mistakes. 
✔️ Speaking 85% of the class time -- I make sure to ask plenty of questions to keep you talking, expressing, explaining, debating, and describing. 

*All* materials and notes will be sent to you after the class for review. Homework may be given to prepare for the next class. Let's get started! 🚀

pro_course_detail.title: American English Pronunciation - Accent Reduction
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you tired of feeling misunderstood? Are you unsure of how to pronounce the most basic words? 

In this class, you can expect: 
 ✔️ Fundamentals of the American English language -- identifying and applying the different consonants and vowels, contrasting them with your native tongue.
 ✔️ Fast English -- understanding reductions (gimme/wanna) and linking for a more natural spoken flow.
 ✔️ Intonation and rhythm -- sounding less robotic and elevating your overall speaking proficiency.

*45 MINUTES MAX* Let's get started! 🚀

pro_course_detail.title: CAE Exam Preparation and Tutoring
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you feel frustrated trying to study for the FCE/CAE exam? Have you hit a wall in your learning? 

Here's what you can expect: 
✔️An initial placement test to identify your strengths and weaknesses so we can immediately target these areas in our classes.
✔️ Cambridge-certified exam preparation material to ensure you are familiar with all aspects of the exam. 
✔️ Speaking practice in every class with corrections and analysis 
✔️ Homework -- sample exam exercises, grammar, reading comprehension or writing. All homework will be checked. 
✔️ Constant feedback throughout our lessons, focusing on vocabulary, grammar, pronunciation, accuracy, fluency, and exam strategies whenever possible. 

As with any of the exams, it's important that you practice as much as possible on your own, too. Self-study is crucial for practice and preparation. Remember, you can do it! 

If you have any other questions, please feel free to contact me. 🚀
